protocol.scope: Compute the identical persistent-context canonical digest once per manifest build. Hash already-normalized prompt/context text without normalizing it again. Evaluate one module-owned EOL regexp rather than a new regexp per normalization. No cross-request or cross-dispatch cache: mutable schema/context has no trustworthy version.
protocol.callChain: SDK resource/tool/transform assembly -> PrefixRequestObservation intent -> buildPrefixManifest -> normalization/canonical hash/SEGMENT_METADATA -> actual provider effective callback -> fresh build and drift comparison -> result/abort/supersede/dispose release. Existing SDK input arrays, Map metadata, serializers and comparison closures remain explicitly accounted; no new cache or pool.
correctness: Exact serialized manifest and diagnostic equality against base for LF/CRLF, Unicode, whitespace and logical paths
Semantic tools/context precedence/transforms order and unordered sibling permutations
Same-object schema/context mutation between builds and effective retries must remain observable
Effective dispatch override/fallback, failures and missing observation, context and credential generation
Large bodies do not become retained by result metadata; no global context memoization
protocol.structural: Intent persistent-context canonical traversal 2 -> 1 per build; each prompt/context content normalized at most once. Effective build already has one canonical context traversal and must not regress. Zero added hot closures/Promise/controllers, no object pools.

performance.target: Repeated allocation reduction and CPU improvement beyond baseline band on context-heavy intent; context-free intent and effective dispatch are negative controls.
performance.gate: PF00: max(5%, maximum absolute process-p95 deviation from baseline median), repeated non-target regression blocks; >10% baseline band requires diagnosis, not wider acceptance. Batch mean p95 is not request latency. Separate profiles, controlled GC before warmup.

protocol.lifecycle: Five ending modes: completion, error, abort, supersede, dispose. Existing request input released; manifest WeakMap metadata contains only hashes/identifiers, not content/schema. Three independent GC runs plus full production event/queue gates.
protocol.limits: Offline synthetic and real SDK tests. No claim about remote cache eligibility, actual cache hits, account identity or paid online behavior. Retain prior PF05 isolated-nanosecond timing V in PF08. No native terminal latency claim.

comparison.bandDefinition: Maximum absolute relative deviation of process p95 values from their median. Initial effective-128 baseline >10% is retained separately; control followup uses longer identical windows on both sides.

data.limits: Diagnostic hooks only; timing/profile drivers do not install these wrappers.
